tools.name: futures_index
tools.description: Query the GEX-GCI general compute futures index (HEH = H100-equivalent hour)

tools.name: futures_trade
tools.description: Futures trading: open / close / close_all / quote / cancel

tools.name: futures_mandate
tools.description: Create a mandate: a principal authorises an agent to trade within limits, never to withdraw

tools.name: futures_open
tools.description: Open an account (no KYC, no email, no geography)

tools.name: gpu_cheapest
tools.description: Cheapest GPU price across all venues

tools.name: exchange_book
tools.description: Matching order book (resting bids, asks and recent fills)

tools.name: place_compute_order
tools.description: Place a compute bid (settled in USDC)

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: futures_open · Public sink: futures_open.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: futures_open · Public sink: futures_open

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
